title: LLM Evaluations and Unit Testing for CI/CD
description: A research project to explore and select a framework for LLM evaluations and unit testing, integrating it into our CI/CD pipeline. This project has very little initial content; the most important task is research. The primary candidates for investigation are Langfuse and DeepEval. The main goal is to establish a robust process for evaluating and ensuring the quality of our LLM-based systems.
action_items: Research Langfuse's features for LLM evaluation.
Research DeepEval's capabilities for unit testing LLMs.
Create a comparative analysis of Langfuse vs. DeepEval.
Develop a proposal for an implementation and integration plan into our CI/CD pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: A document comparing Langfuse and DeepEval with a recommendation for Cogni is produced.
A proof-of-concept implementation for the chosen framework is created.
